decisions.decision: The Board agreed the override would move forward procedurally, with an article on the Town Meeting warrant and a question on the ballot, though no formal vote was recorded on the override itself.
decisions.quote: chair jeffreys noted general consensus among the board to move the override forward

decisions.decision: The Board and Town Manager will finalize the override amount and make the ballot and warrant language match.
decisions.quote: the board and town manager will finalize the override amount and ensure the ballot and warrant language match.

decisions.decision: Any new savings or revenue is to be used to reduce the override, particularly for school needs.
decisions.quote: they agreed that any new savings or revenue should be used to reduce the override, particularly for school needs.
